description: Here’s what I’d do as a creative strategist at @Alix Earle’s new brand @reale actives…
transcript: Let's make a creative roadmap for Alex Earle's new brand. I use Claude to make two reports for real active since they're in a really successful launch phase and aren't running meta ads right now. Number one, an analysis on every single post that they've ever made on the brand page, including user feedback. And No. 2, an analysis on everything that Alex has posted about acne in the last six months. So their initial strategy needs to focus on two areas proving efficacy on acne, do the products work or not? And number two, expanding use cases so people who maybe don't have acne can still feel confident buying the products. For number one, I'd pitch a real acne customer video series that follows the 30 day period of people who have acne trying out the products. The two biggest concerns are if the product works and accutane attribution. So I'd really wanna focus on working with creators that are both Gen Z and 35+ who experience acne and and then a third group who have taken prescription medications to normalize Accutane aftercare. This would also generate great before and after images to increase performance on paid now. Number two is gonna go after the audience of people who really support Alex Earle but maybe don't have acne. Maybe they have normal skin or maybe they have a different skin concern like rosacea or more sensitive skin. Essentially, this audience is gonna be really easy to convert. They just Need that additional reassurance. So I'd address this head on with a collab series between Alex and Doctor Neon, whose content has performed really well for Alex's audience in the past. I'd also make sure we have great grid stats and hero images, with Alex to act as the bottom of funnel. Let me know what brand I should do next.
